resandpay_blog_title: Designing an App-in-App Architecture: RetEX on ResandPay's Restaurant Service Integration
resandpay_blog_desc: How to scale an existing multi-service app without breaking core code by adopting the 'App-in-App' (Dual-Core) architectural paradigm and strict cart management.
resandpay_ctx: In Cameroon's urban food service industry, long customer wait times at peak hours lead to customer churn and revenue loss. The mission at KMSS SARL was to enrich the ResandPay app with a hybrid dining business model.
resandpay_arch: Built on an isolated 'App-in-App' (Dual-Core) paradigm, separating the restaurant universe while sharing core infrastructure. The stack uses React Native (TypeScript) with Expo, Redux Store for cart persistence, a Laravel REST API, and real-time Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM).
resandpay_chal:
• Strict single-establishment cart rule: Prevention of mixing items from different vendors via Redux logic.
• Flexible fulfillment modes: Click & Collect, Dine-In (with mandatory table number input), and Delivery.
• Cancellation lock: Disabling user cancellation once orders shift to PREPARING.
resandpay_res: Successful integration of 25 pilot restaurants, drastic reduction in wait times, seamless mobile-to-backend communication, and secure transactions via the ResandPay Wallet.
mamacare_blog_title: MamaCare: From Design to Production of a Maternal and Child Health Mobile App
mamacare_blog_desc: Comprehensive retrospective on our Software Engineering BSc thesis project: a unified, secure ecosystem for pregnancy and early childhood tracking.
mamacare_ctx: Maternal and child health is a major public health challenge in Cameroon, characterized by concerning mortality rates and limited access to reliable medical information. MamaCare provides a trusted digital companion centralizing pregnancy tracking, child health, appointments, and a community space.
mamacare_arch: A three-tier architecture featuring a React Native / Expo 54.0 mobile frontend with TypeScript, a robust Laravel 11 / PHP 8.3 REST API backend, and a document-oriented MongoDB Atlas cloud database.
mamacare_chal:
• Secure hybrid authentication: Pairing Firebase Auth with a custom JWT token validation middleware in Laravel.
• Algorithmic automation: Dynamic calculation of pregnancy weeks, estimated due dates (EDD), and automated status updates for PEV vaccination schedules.
• Production resilience: Fixing Render timeouts, managing Axios interceptors, and integrating SHA fingerprints for Firebase release.
mamacare_res: Fully functional Android APK distributed, validated through rigorous user testing with healthcare professionals and young mothers, paving the way for telemedicine and electronic health record integration.

foodgo.shortDescription: Multi-restaurant food ordering and delivery mobile platform with real-time GPS tracking.
foodgo.longDescription: Foodgo is a comprehensive food ordering and delivery mobile application built with React Native and Expo. The platform connects customers, restaurants, and drivers in a unified ecosystem: customers browse nearby restaurants, customize their dishes, and track their orders in real time on an interactive map. mamacare.title: MamaCare Backend - Maternal and Infant Health API
mamacare.shortDescription: Secure API for managing pregnancy follow-up, infant health, vaccinations, and medical appointments
mamacare.longDescription: The MamaCare backend is a RESTful API built with Laravel 12, designed to centralize and secure health data for mothers and children. It handles authentication for users and healthcare professionals, personalized pregnancy tracking (key dates, medical measurements, symptoms), pediatric records (growth, vaccinations, symptoms), appointment scheduling, notification delivery (push, SMS, email), as well as health center management and professional access control. Its modular architecture and encryption protocols ensure the confidentiality of medical data and regulatory compliance. The backend powers both the mobile application and the administration dashboard, providing a seamless experience even with limited connectivity through adapted synchronization mechanisms.

pregnancy_tracking: Smart pregnancy tracking — React Native/Expo, Laravel 12 API, automatic calculations (EDD, week, trimester), charts with react-native-chart-kit, notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging.
child_tracking: Child growth tracking (0-5 years) — React Native, Laravel API, react-native-chart-kit, WHO data for percentiles, MongoDB storage.
vaccination: Vaccination with automated reminders — Laravel Scheduler + Queues, Firebase Cloud Messaging react-native-firebase/messaging, expo-notifications, PDF generation with DomPDF.
education_nutrition: Education, nutrition and food diary — Laravel CMS, React Native, AsyncStorage for offline mode,PDF/Excel for exports.
secure_auth: Secure multi-role authentication — Firebase Authentication, Firebase Admin SDK, Laravel Sanctum, Firebase tokens, PIN code in AsyncStorage/SecureStore, GDPR encryption, MongoDB for session, log, and user data storage.
admin_dashboard: Administrator dashboard — Livewire, Laravel API, Chart.js/Recharts, MongoDB for aggregations and statistics collections.
multichannel_notifications: Multi-channel notification engine — Firebase Cloud Messaging, Laravel Queues, MongoDB for notification history, templates, and deliverability tracking.
healthcare_professionals_space: Healthcare professionals portal — Laravel API, React Native, Firebase Auth, role-based access control and permissions, MongoDB for patient records, consultations, and professional access.
mamacare_description: MamaCare is a maternal and child health mobile application designed for pregnant women and mothers of children aged 0 to 5. It offers personalized pregnancy tracking (expected delivery date calculation, weekly advice, weight curves, danger sign alerts) and comprehensive child monitoring (measurements, WHO growth charts, developmental journal, nutrition). Vaccination is managed with an official schedule, automatic push notification reminders, and PDF booklet generation. The app also includes an emergency module with health center geolocation and direct calling, as well as an education and nutrition space (physician-validated articles, local recipes, food diary, quiz). An offline mode enables data entry and consultation without a connection, with automatic synchronization. Healthcare professionals (doctors, midwives) have a dedicated space to monitor their patients, enter prenatal checks, and consult medical records with consent. Authentication relies on Firebase Authentication with mandatory two-factor verification (without SMS), and data is secured and encrypted in compliance with GDPR. The backend uses Laravel 12 with MongoDB for data storage, and the mobile application is developed with React Native/Expo.
mamacare_backend_description: The MamaCare backend is a REST API developed with Laravel 12, providing secure authentication based on Firebase and Sanctum, with systematic verification of Firebase tokens. It manages all system entities: users (complete CRUD), pregnancies, children, health measurements (weight, blood pressure, etc.), symptoms, vaccinations, appointments, health centers, healthcare professionals, notifications (push,  email), educational content, recipes and nutrition, as well as emergencies. The API also features PDF and Excel report generation, analytics and statistics functionalities, Machine Learning models for predicting pregnancy and malnutrition risks, offline synchronization, sensitive data encryption, GDPR compliance, logging and auditing, and is documented via OpenAPI/Swagger. The MongoDB database stores the main entities as collections: users (users), pregnancies (pregnancies), children (children), health measurements (health_measurements), vaccinations (vaccinations), consultations and appointments (appointments, consultations), health centers (health_centers), professionals (professionals), notifications (notifications), educational contents (educational_contents), recipes (recipes), food journals (food_journals), emergencies (emergencies), and audit logs (audit_logs).

resandpay_restaurant_desc: The project consists of integrating a restaurant module within the existing ResAndPay application as an 'App-in-App'. Specifically, the user remains within the same mobile application but can switch between two distinct universes: the Restaurant universe (new) and the ResAndPay universe (existing). This switch is done via a visual toggle (segmented control) displayed at the top of the screen. The goal is to offer a seamless restaurant ordering and reservation experience without leaving the application. Users can browse a list of restaurants, view their menus, add dishes to a cart, book a table, pay, and track their order status. The module reuses the payment and notification infrastructure already present in ResAndPay, ensuring fast and consistent integration. The visual identity features a white theme with green accents, specific to the restaurant universe.
universe_switch: Universe switching: a visual toggle allows switching from the ResAndPay universe to the Restaurant universe, with a blocker if an active travel booking exists.
dedicated_navigation: Dedicated navigation: a restaurant-specific bottom tab navigator (Home, Detail, Cart, Orders) for a smooth and independent experience.
restaurants_discovery: Restaurant discovery: home screen featuring a promotional carousel, category grid, and restaurant list (image, rating, pickup time).
menu_consultation: Menu browsing: detail page with a collapsible header, category-organized menu, and one-click item addition to the cart.
cart_management: Cart management: adding, removing, and modifying items via Redux, with a restriction against mixing multiple restaurants in a single cart.
table_booking: Table reservation: modal with date/time picker and guest count, with the option to book without ordering food.
integrated_payment: Integrated payment: reuses the existing useBookingPayment hook; handles the zero-total reservation case without payment processing.
order_tracking: Order tracking: screen listing orders with their status (PENDING, PREPARING, READY) and a cancellation option only if permitted by status.
realtime_notifications: Real-time notifications: receiving updates via Firebase Cloud Messaging, transforming them into readable messages, and deep linking to order details.
business_rules_history: Business rules and history: blocking universe switching if a booking is active, preventing mixed restaurant carts, and integrating restaurant order history into the user's global profile.
user_management_api: API and management system for users, vendors, products, orders, and deliveries featuring smart driver assignment.
delivery_backend_detailed_desc: The delivery application backend is a REST API designed to handle all logistical and commercial flows of the platform. It relies on a role and permission system (admin, vendor, delivery_agent, client) with manual validation for professional accounts. It manages vendors (restaurants, pharmacies, supermarkets, etc.) and their products, with a hierarchical classification by types and subtypes. Customer orders are tied to a single vendor and automatically trigger a delivery. External deliveries (via API or manual form) are also supported. Driver assignment follows three strategies: automatic (dispatch), manual (admin), or semi-automatic (assisted suggestion). Pricing is dynamically calculated based on distance, weight, vehicle type, and configurable rules. The system handles payments, PDF invoicing, webhook notifications for external partners, and real-time delivery tracking.
